authority: District of Columbia Department of Energy and Environment

preflight.reason: The official page included changing analytics markup. Only the stable official invasive-plant table was serialized and retained after three matching independent captures.

resources.adaptation: Heavy acquisition, shared compilation, production build, and deployment were not started. Low-memory official-source acquisition, deterministic normalization, exact taxonomy review, and integration preparation continued.

contradictions.subject: dated-production-checkpoint
contradictions.priorState: The reusable prompt identified 326f98383ce0f532078c9346964ad950e24a38bd as the latest production checkpoint.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Canonical main, origin main, GitHub main, GitHub deployment 5701600051, Vercel deployment dpl_6MVatfaEsyds3ZU9RxpsrSJHt1Cn, and live production all resolved to 879c3871ad73b7d38cd2396fcfe8a77b6df1b162 before this source was acquired.
contradictions.resolution: The dated checkpoint remains preserved as history and was not recreated.

contradictions.subject: source-claim-scope
contradictions.priorState: The source registry supported regulated applicability only, while the official District page is an advisory invasive-plant guide rather than a regulation.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The official table explicitly labels 22 plants as DC invasive pollinator plants, and 14 rows are exact current catalog binomials.
contradictions.resolution: The schema and deterministic merge now preserve a separate high-priority applicability semantic. No row was represented as regulated, and no county occurrence or negative evidence was created.

contradictions.subject: dynamic-full-page-bytes
contradictions.priorState: A complete raw page capture was initially considered for the official-web source.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Analytics markup changed between requests while the official invasive table remained byte-stable across three independent captures.
contradictions.resolution: The changing full page was not retained. The analytics-free official table serialization is the only operative artifact, and its exact hash, byte count, parsing denominator, and capture method are pinned.

contradictions.subject: memory-floor
contradictions.priorState: The reusable prompt requires a hard 3072 MiB available-memory floor before launching a new heavy worker.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Available physical memory was 1873.41 MiB initially and 2648.89 MiB at the final sample; a temporary high sample of 3329.96 MiB still did not leave the measured 1244 MiB worker safety budget above the floor.
contradictions.resolution: No heavy worker, compiler, build, or deployment was started. Productive low-memory official-source work continued without closing user applications.
